# Othello endgame puzzles scraped from othelloclub.com/en/puzzle_ep.php
# ("daily endgame puzzle" archive — the task there is literally "win from here",
# which is the task we give participants).
#
# Format, one puzzle per line:   DATE|TURN|BOARD
#   DATE  = the puzzle's publication date (YYYYMMDD), used as its id
#   TURN  = side to move on the site: 1 = Black, 2 = White
#   BOARD = the site's 64-character board string, row by row from the top:
#           0 = empty, 1 = black, 2 = white
#
# import_puzzles.py reads this file, solves each position exactly, and (with
# --write) emits puzzle_config_oc<DATE>.txt + solution_oc<DATE>.json. Puzzles
# that are White to move are color-flipped on import so the participant is
# always Black — the position is strategically identical, only relabelled.
#
# Fetched 2026-07-29 (the 20 most recent puzzles at that time).
